meta.title: Usar elipsis, sustitución y referencia
meta.goal: Puedes evitar repeticiones con auxiliares, sustitutos y referencias claras sin obligar al lector a adivinar el antecedente.

cards.title: Omite, sustituye o señala
cards.lede: Estos mecanismos reducen repetición, pero operan de manera distinta.

rows.value: I ordered the soup, and Maya did too. (= ordered the soup)
The blue charger is faster than the old one.
The city expanded the program. This decision drew criticism.
El antecedente debe estar activo y admitir una sola interpretación razonable.

cards.title: Reutiliza el predicado con do, be y modales
cards.lede: Conserva el auxiliar que corresponde al tiempo y a la estructura original.

columns.label: Afirmación
examples: Lena can join, and Omar can too.
Lena can join, and so can Omar.

columns.label: Negación
columns.rule: auxiliary + not + either / neither + auxiliary + subject
examples: I wasn't invited, and Sam wasn't either.
I wasn't invited, and neither was Sam.

columns.label: Contraste
columns.rule: subject + auxiliary, but subject + auxiliary not
examples: The first test worked, but the second one didn't.

cards.title: One, ones, so y not recuperan contenido
cards.lede: Elige el sustituto según recuperes un sustantivo contable o una proposición completa.

rows.value: I need a cable. Do you have a longer one?
Employees may work remotely if they choose to do so.
Will prices fall? Analysts expect so.
Is the store still open? I hope not.

cards.title: Nombra el alcance de this y that
cards.lede: Un pronombre aislado puede apuntar a un hecho, una decisión o una frase entera; un sustantivo guía la interpretación.

columns.label: Referencia vaga
examples: Sales fell after prices rose. This was unexpected.

columns.label: Referencia guiada
examples: Sales fell after prices rose. This decline was unexpected.
The board delayed the vote. That decision frustrated investors.

cards.title: Haz coincidir auxiliar y antecedente
cards.lede: La forma elíptica conserva tiempo, polaridad y modalidad del predicado omitido.

lines.text: Nora has finished, and Luis does too.
Nora has finished, and Luis has too.
I didn't enjoy it, and neither did Maya not.
I didn't enjoy it, and neither did Maya.
The laptop is lighter than the tablet one.
The laptop is lighter than the tablet.
lines.note: One no sustituye nombres usados como contraste de clase de este modo.

cards.title: Edita un párrafo sin perder claridad
cards.lede: Reduce repetición solo después de asegurar que cada referencia tenga un antecedente inequívoco.

rows.value: The east entrance needs repairs. The west entrance needs repairs too. The repairs will be expensive.
The east entrance needs repairs, and the west one does too. This work will be expensive.
¿One sustituye un sustantivo contable? ¿Does recupera el mismo predicado? ¿This work resume una idea clara?
Repite el sustantivo si hay dos antecedentes posibles o si empieza un tema nuevo.

tip.label: Reto
tip.body: Edita cinco frases repetitivas usando al menos una elipsis, una sustitución y un sustantivo resumen.

quiz.q: Complete: Ava has signed the form, and Leo ___ too.
quiz.explain: La elipsis conserva el auxiliar has del present perfect.

quiz.q: Which version has the clearest reference?
options: The deadline moved after the scope changed. This caused concern.
The deadline moved after the scope changed. This delay caused concern.
quiz.explain: This delay identifica qué aspecto de la oración anterior causó preocupación.

quiz.q: Complete: Will the plan work? I hope ___.
quiz.explain: So sustituye la proposición completa the plan will work.

options: I can't attend, and neither can Jo.
I can't attend, and neither Jo can't.
I can't attend, and Jo does neither.
quiz.explain: Neither + auxiliar + sujeto expresa concordancia negativa con inversión.
